note: Everything waiting on the founder, in one place (founder, 2026-10-13: 'All tasks waiting for me should be visible in HQ and consolidated'). The chief of staff keeps this file; HQ's Lobby and banner read it, plus any open board item owned by 'founder'. Each item says why it matters, the options, a recommendation and where the evidence is. When the founder answers, the chief of staff sets status 'decided', records the answer, and writes the decision record.

items.title: Backend: auth provider, database host, and whether learners may be under 13
